narr: Thunderstorms produced flash flooding in San Angelo.
ev: An NWS Employee was reporting very heavy rainfall which was causing urban flooding, resulting in vehicles close enough to getting stuck. It was very difficult to see road with wipers on full speed. This was occurring along Southland Blvd from Knickerbocker Rd to Southwest Blvd.
An amateur radio operator reported that Sul Ross Rd at the Red Arroyo was impassable and emergency vehicles was blocking the entrance.
lsr: VERY HEAVY RAINFALL CAUSING URBAN FLOODING, ENOUGH WHEN VEHICLES WERE CLOSE TO GETTING STUCK. VERY DIFFICULT TO SEE ROAD EVEN WITH WIPERS ON FULL SPEED. MAINLY FROM KNICKERBOCKER RD. TO SOUTHWEST BLV
AN AMATEUR RADIO OPERATOR REPORTED THAT SUL ROSS AT THE RED ARROYO WAS IMPASSABLE AND HAD EMERGENCY VEHICLES BLOCKING THE ENTRANCE.
